evidence: Built the requirement -> criterion map from instruction.md and all six notes against 3 gate, 42 functional, 6 polish and 3 visual criteria. disabled Undo/Redo -> polish/judge.toml:45. ui.md:11 literal Find with dot/bracket, wrap, current match selected, Replace current/all, self-containing replacement, redo cleared by new edit -> :132,:141,:150,:159. ui.md:13 JS and HTML colouring -> :168,:177. ui.md:15 Format JS/HTML, two-space, idempotent, one undo/redo, syntax-error draft kept -> :187,:195,:204. ui.md:17 controls, labels, focus, keyboard exit, worded feedback, focus return, unsaved marker, 390 px -> polish/judge.toml:18,27,36,54,63. behaviour.md:3 run, HTML mode, fresh document, syntax error, console order, error line for JS/HTML/unhandled rejection, output kept -> :213,:222,:258,:231,:267,:240,:249. behaviour.md:5 last-good restore with typed values and canvas, five-second budget, fresh budget on interaction, later valid Run -> :285,:294,:276. behaviour.md:7 Stop cancels timer/interval/Promise work, newer Run supersedes -> :303,:312. behaviour.md:9 exact save, fresh-page read, restart, stale save refused, dirty draft kept, conflict feedback -> gates/constraints/judge.toml:27, functional :339,:348,:357. behaviour.md:11 live library refresh, editing state preserved, newer-revision notice -> :375,:384,:393. behaviour.md:13 read-only history, restore as new revision, old-revision restore, idempotent retry -> :366. security.md:3-5 isolation, no network from preview, dynamic evaluation refused with harmless strings/comments -> :321,:330. overview.md:3-5 panes together and separate preview -> visual/judge.toml:34 and polish :63. integration.md:3-11 start command, cwd outside /app, port, health, no build step, DB_PATH, symlink rule are exercised by the frozen harness launch (tests/test.sh:48,83,99-110,136,162-166), which is the template's mechanism rather than a criterion. Residual details with no dedicated assertion, none of which is a separately useful product promise: (a) overview.md:3 'New drafts start empty or with a small example' - New is used at functional :344 but the initial content is not asserted, and either permitted outcome passes; (b) integration.md:9 SQLite and the default /app/app.db path when DB_PATH is unset are not browser-observable and the harness always sets DB_PATH (test.sh:109), consistent with REVIEW_POLICY 'a browser exchange cannot prove SQLite'; (c) behaviour.md:5 names Promise callbacks under the run budget while :294 exercises only a source loop and a self-rescheduling timer; (d) behaviour.md:11 says about five seconds while :380/:398 allow ten, which is leniency, not a gap. Scripted golden results for these bytes list every criterion id (results/editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json); that is scripted evidence, not a configured judge run, and this static coverage row does not depend on it.
